description: Create an API key (the raw key is returned once), revoke a key, or change a key's scopes — the dashboard's Developer API controls. Requires the user's confirmation. Keys can also carry the AI-assistant scopes (read:account / write:account) that this connector uses.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

key_id.description: revoke/update_scopes: the key id from list_api_keys.

label.description: create: a name for the key.

scopes.description: Scope ids. Required for update_scopes; create defaults to the standard scopes.

name: manage_api_keys
title: Manage my API keys
